summary: Agriculture wave 2 and the Commerce Sector Offer link, on top of ads-release-20261111: Identity at kit main (migration 008, service clients, agriculture-web token exchange), Commerce main (migration 126, Sector Offer API) and Agriculture main (migrations 009-011). Education, Fleet Guard, Digital Tontine, VentureWorks and the portal keep their ads-release-20261111 pins. No CI, deployment, migration, seed reset, account creation or portal activation happens when this manifest is committed.

immutable_sources.pending_repin: One more pin after the Commerce B1 fix PR (merchant links: a demo persona may sell for its organisation) is merged.
One more pin after the Agriculture B2/B3 fix PRs (sector consent, Compose pass-through of the Commerce link settings, seed) are merged.

hard_gates.preflight: Not run on Contabo; verify live compose project labels/ports/network, SSH credentials, disk capacity, HTTPS issuer and current container/image digests.
hard_gates.source_ci: Exact merged SHAs must be on origin/main; Identity and Commerce images carry sha-<pinned SHA> tags (publish check success); the Agriculture image is built on the host from the pinned SHA and must carry the SHA tag or the OCI revision label.
hard_gates.security: Independent Identity, tenant isolation, grant expiry/revocation, privileged worker and financial mock-mode review required before change window.
hard_gates.backups: Protected pre-change snapshots AND independently verified isolated restores of shared demo Identity, Commerce and Agriculture before their migrations; retain current images.
hard_gates.migration: Only new migrations: Identity 008_service_clients.sql, Commerce 126_sector_offers_v1.sql, Agriculture 009-011, each with its approved migrator after backup and before the new service. Validate RLS and retained rows. Never auto-rollback SQL.
hard_gates.reset: No Commerce --reset and no seed reset in this release.
hard_gates.accounts: QA/partner accounts require confirmed recipient identities and operator-only credential storage; do not commit or print passwords.
hard_gates.activation: Test local health then live HTTPS, OIDC, EN/FR, persona switching, no-access, role/tenant separation, fake-money and rollback; publish portal links last.
hard_gates.approval: Release owner and authorized host operator must approve exact SHA/digests and evidence before any deploy.

existing_workflow_constraint: The contabo-five-demo-release workflow, batch-release.manifest.json and build-staged-demo-images.sh are superseded and refuse to run; they pin stale SHAs. Do not dispatch them for this release.

sector_link.note: When enabled, release-acceptance.sh checks that each listed service client is in the reviewed clients.demo.json service_clients, registered in Identity as an active kind=service client with the reviewed scopes and audiences, and has a secret set (reported yes/no only; no secret or hash is read out). Set enabled to false to skip these checks for a release without the sector link.

kit_repin_note: ads-identity is pinned at kit main b768b47 (PRs #79 and #78; image ghcr.io/ksondo/ads-platform-kit-identity:sha-b768b47b942dd6d4b97027b753b2c610d3037bc1). ads-portal keeps 119eb340: the portal is not redeployed in this release.
repin_instructions: Commerce and Agriculture get one more pin after the B1-B3 fix PRs merge. Change only the sha (and pr/migration/pending_repin) of the commerce and agriculture entries in this file, update the matching rows of ADS_RELEASE_20261111B.md, then run python3 -m unittest discover -s deploy/contabo-demo -p 'test_release_acceptance.py'. See ADS_RELEASE_20261111B.md, 'Bumping the Commerce and Agriculture pins'.
acceptance_check: deploy/contabo-demo/release-acceptance.sh (read-only; run on the host before opening each product)
